title: Camden Emergency Help Points
summary: Central emergency medical departments, urgent care clinics, subterranean drainage hazards, and supply streets in Camden.
content:
For life-threatening emergencies, call 999 or 112 immediately.

1. Nearest 24-Hour A&E Hospitals
- University College Hospital (UCH): 235 Euston Road, London NW1 2BU. From Warren Street station: ~2 min walk east along Euston Road (~150m); from Euston station: ~5 min walk west along Euston Road (~400m).
- Royal Free Hospital: Pond Street, Hampstead NW3 2QG. From Hampstead Heath station: ~3 min walk north along South End Road and Pond Street (~250m); from Belsize Park station: ~12 min walk north-east via Fleet Road (~0.6 miles).
- St Mary's Hospital (Major Trauma Centre): Praed Street, Paddington W2 1NY (~1.5 miles west of Bloomsbury via Euston Road and Marylebone Road).

2. Urgent Treatment Centres
- University College Hospital Urgent Treatment Centre: Ground Floor, Elizabeth Garrett Anderson Wing, Grafton Way, London WC1E 6DB. Immediate walking distance from UCH main building and Warren Street station.

3. Local Hazards
- Hidden River Fleet culvert route creates severe surface-water flash flood risk during heavy downpours, running from Hampstead Heath through Kentish Town, Camden Town, and King's Cross.

4. Essential Supplies
- Supermarkets and pharmacies along Camden High Street, Kentish Town Road, Tottenham Court Road, and Kilburn High Road supply bottled water, hygiene essentials, and batteries.

Note: addresses and opening hours may have changed — confirm on arrival where possible.
